cases.sentence: Прекрасное, тонкое и молодое еще ___ его... просияло улыбкой, когда он увидел Левина.
cases.translation: His handsome, delicate, still-young face... lit up with a smile when he saw Levin.
cases.explain: Лицо is the subject of просияло (lit up), so it stands in the nominative case.

cases.translation: "They require it of Misha, and it's so difficult."
cases.explain: The preposition от (from/of) governs the genitive case, giving Миши.

cases.sentence: ...я всегда учусь тому, что мне предстоит, именно ___ детей.
cases.translation: ...I am always learning what lies ahead of me, namely the upbringing of children.
cases.explain: The verb учусь (учиться чему, 'to learn something') governs the dative case, giving воспитанию.

cases.sentence: ...перешел на службу в дворцовое ведомство в ___ для того, чтобы дать наилучшее воспитание своим двум мальчикам.
cases.translation: ...and transferred to a position in the palace department in Moscow, in order to give his two boys the best possible upbringing.
cases.explain: The preposition в expressing motion/direction governs the accusative case, giving Москву.

cases.sentence: ...осторожно на отлете держа красивую ___ до половины испеплившуюся сигару.
cases.translation: ...carefully holding, at arm's length, a fine half-burned cigar with his hand.
cases.explain: The instrumental case here expresses the means/instrument, giving рукой (with his hand).

cases.sentence: Львов... всю свою жизнь провел в столицах и за ___...
cases.translation: Lvov...had spent his whole life in the capitals and abroad...
cases.explain: The preposition за (beyond) in the idiom за границей (abroad) governs the instrumental case, giving границей.

cases.translation: Lvov...was reading a book that stood on the reading-stand.
cases.explain: The preposition на (on) governs the prepositional case, giving пюпитре.

reading.ru: Львов, женатый на Натали, сестре Кити, всю свою жизнь провел в столицах и за границей, где он и воспитывался, и служил дипломатом.
reading.question: What had Lvov's life mostly consisted of before moving to Moscow?
options: Living in capital cities and abroad, where he was educated and served as a diplomat
reading.correct: Living in capital cities and abroad, where he was educated and served as a diplomat
reading.explain: The text says Lvov spent his whole life in capital cities and abroad, where he was educated and served as a diplomat.

reading.ru: В прошлом году он оставил дипломатическую службу не по неприятности, у него никогда ни с кем не бывало неприятностей, и перешел на службу в дворцовое ведомство в Москву для того, чтобы дать наилучшее воспитание своим двум мальчикам.
reading.question: Why did Lvov transfer to a position in Moscow?
options: To give his two sons the best possible upbringing
Because he was dismissed from the diplomatic service
To be closer to his sister-in-law Kitty
reading.correct: To give his two sons the best possible upbringing
reading.explain: The text says he transferred to Moscow in order to give his two boys the best upbringing.

reading.ru: Несмотря на самую резкую противоположность в привычках и во взглядах, и на то, что Львов был старше Левина, они в эту зиму очень сошлись и полюбили друг друга.
reading.question: Despite their differences in habits and views, what happened between Lvov and Levin that winter?
options: They became very close and grew fond of each other
They had a bitter falling out
reading.correct: They became very close and grew fond of each other
reading.explain: The text says that despite their sharp differences, they became close and fond of each other that winter.

reading.ru: Прекрасное, тонкое и молодое еще лицо его, которому курчавые блестящие серебряные волосы придавали еще более породистое выражение, просияло улыбкой, когда он увидел Левина.
reading.question: How did Lvov react upon seeing Levin arrive?
options: His face lit up with a smile
He pretended not to notice him
reading.correct: His face lit up with a smile
reading.explain: The text says Lvov's face lit up with a smile when he saw Levin.

reading.ru: Левин рассказал слышанное от Котовасова о том, что говорят в Петербурге, и, поговорив о политике, рассказал про свое знакомство с Метровым и поездку в заседание.
reading.question: What did Levin tell Lvov about during their conversation?
options: News from Kotovasov, politics, and his new acquaintance with Metrov
His plans to move back to the country
His disagreement with Kitty about money
The upcoming birth of his child
reading.correct: News from Kotovasov, politics, and his new acquaintance with Metrov
reading.explain: The text says Levin recounted what he heard from Kotovasov, discussed politics, and told of his acquaintance with Metrov.

reading.ru: А потом я не стыжусь сказать, что мое образование слишком недостаточно».
reading.question: What did Lvov admit about himself to Levin?
options: That his own education was too insufficient
That he wished to return to diplomacy
reading.correct: That his own education was too insufficient
reading.explain: Lvov admits he is not ashamed to say his own education is too insufficient.

reading.ru: Я только знаю, — сказал Левин, — что я не видал лучше воспитанных детей, чем ваши, и не желал бы детей лучше ваших».
reading.question: What did Levin tell Lvov about his children?
options: That he had never seen better-raised children than Lvov's
That Lvov's children were poorly disciplined
That he preferred his own upbringing methods
That the boys needed a stricter tutor
reading.correct: That he had never seen better-raised children than Lvov's
reading.explain: Levin says he has never seen better-raised children than Lvov's.

reading.ru: Если не иметь опоры в религии, помните, мы с вами говорили, то никакой отец одними своими силами без этой помощи не мог бы воспитывать.
reading.question: What did Lvov believe was necessary for raising children properly?
options: A foundation in religion, without which no father could manage alone
A private tutor for every subject
reading.correct: A foundation in religion, without which no father could manage alone
reading.explain: Lvov says that without support in religion, no father could manage to raise children by his own strength alone.

reading.ru: Интересовавший всегда Левина разговор этот был прерван вошедшую, одетую уже для выезда, красавицей Натальей Александровной.
reading.question: How was the conversation between Levin and Lvov interrupted?
options: By Natalie entering, already dressed to go out
By the boys running into the room crying
reading.correct: By Natalie entering, already dressed to go out
reading.explain: The text says the conversation was interrupted by the beautiful Natalya Alexandrovna entering, already dressed to go out.

reading.ru: Решено было, что Левин поедет с Натали в концерт и на публичное заседание, а оттуда карету пришлют в контору за Арсением
reading.question: What was decided about the evening's plans?
options: That Levin would go with Natalie to the concert and public meeting
That Levin would stay home with the children
That Lvov would go alone to the concert
That everyone would stay in for the evening
reading.correct: That Levin would go with Natalie to the concert and public meeting
reading.explain: The text says it was decided Levin would go with Natalie to the concert and the public meeting.

reading.ru: Вот он меня портит», — сказал Львов жене. «Уверяет меня, что наши дети прекрасны, когда я знаю, что в них столько дурного».
reading.question: What did Lvov jokingly accuse Levin of doing?
options: Spoiling him by insisting the children were wonderful
reading.correct: Spoiling him by insisting the children were wonderful
reading.explain: Lvov jokingly tells his wife that Levin spoils him by insisting their children are wonderful.

reading.ru: Ну вот, подите сюда, совершенные дети!» — сказал он входившим красавцам мальчикам, которые, поклонившись Левину, подошли к отцу, очевидно желая о чем-то спросить его.
reading.question: What did the two boys do when they entered the room?
options: They bowed to Levin and approached their father wanting to ask him something
They ran to hide behind their mother
They argued loudly with each other
They ignored everyone in the room
reading.correct: They bowed to Levin and approached their father wanting to ask him something
reading.explain: The text says the boys, having bowed to Levin, went up to their father, evidently wanting to ask him something.

reading.ru: Ах, Китти мне поручила что-то переговорить с вами об Облонском», — сказал он, когда Львов остановился на лестнице, провожая жену и его.
reading.question: What did Levin suddenly remember as he was leaving?
options: That Kitty had asked him to talk to Lvov about Oblonsky
That he had forgotten his coat
That he needed to visit the bank
That he had promised to write to Metrov
reading.correct: That Kitty had asked him to talk to Lvov about Oblonsky
reading.explain: Levin remembers that Kitty had charged him to talk with Lvov about Oblonsky.
